po_authorization_ref: Product-Owner decision of 2026-08-14 authorizing Phase 5 for complete end-to-end implementation and VERIFIED LIVE-DARK / NO-FINANCIAL-TRAFFIC validation on the DEVELOPMENT appliance, executed as four substantial milestones with automatic continuation while gates are green.
history_note: Phases 0, 1A, 1B, 2, 3 and 4 remain ACCEPTED_AND_CLOSED / FINAL_CLOSED and are unchanged. T0044 through T0049 are unchanged. The six accepted Phase-4 limitations are preserved and NOT promoted.
product_decisions_fixed_by_this_authoriz: Post-Stay v1 is INCLUDED / ZERO-PRICE ONLY. No financial enablement and no real settlement.
A Cross-PMS transfer REFUSES until the destination Stay already exists from verified PMS state. Synthetic PMS state is never created.

Post-Stay PIN issuance may occur ONLY from an already-authenticated guest context (before checkout or during Checkout Grace), with secure one-time reveal. Operator reset/re-issue requires authorization, step-up and audit. There is no anonymous room-number-based issuance.
Post-Stay v1 is STAY-EPISODE scoped exactly as the FINAL contract defines it. No per-sharer identities are invented.

stay_links(reason='POST_STAY') is NOT written: the FINAL contract does not ground both of its NOT NULL Stay ends for Post-Stay, and writing it would require synthetic PMS state. The post_stay_profiles origin lineage is the contract-grounded mechanism and is sufficient.
Multi-PMS ambiguity is a REVIEW SIGNAL ONLY, never proof of transfer. Transfer execution requires explicit verified source and destination Stays and a staff-confirmed atomic action.
No database roles and no commit count are pre-committed. Least privilege is derived from an actual privilege audit.
One Phase branch and one pull request.
what_this_authorization_does_not_authori: Real financial traffic, settlement, PMS posting, P# allocation or provider traffic.
Paid guest access or any non-zero Post-Stay price.
Deployment to anything other than the DEVELOPMENT appliance.
Creation of any synthetic Stay or synthetic PMS state.
